description: This source file defines the 'ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric' class, which monitors and calculates the standard deviation of control errors in a closed-loop control system. It uses a buffer to store recent error measurements and schedules periodic tasks to update sensor values based on traffic data.

classes.name: ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric
classes.description: A class that measures and evaluates the quality of closed-loop control by calculating error metrics over time and updating sensor values periodically.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the scheduled executor to periodically compute error metrics and update sensor data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the error buffer to clear current error history.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates and returns the standard deviation of recent errors.

methods.name: rememberCurrentError
methods.description: Adds a newly calculated error value to the buffer.
